_source: Appendix A of the 26/27 LP Meeting Plan names the same 28 weeks and titles for Grade 7 Science (Studies Weekly) as Grade 6 and Grade 8 - confirmed identical to studies_weekly_g6_science.json and studies_weekly_g8_science.json by Loren 8/29/26. Excluded from the original build_studies_weekly_weeks.py pass because reconstructing Grade 7's per-LP grouping from this week data fails at LP9-10 - the course runs self-paced from that point, so the standard LP-window grouping (STANDARD_WINDOWS) does not reproduce generate_plan.content_for's output there, even though the week titles themselves are identical to Grade 6 and Grade 8. This file carries the week titles only; do not use its weeks 29-34 (if ever added) to assume standard LP9 grouping without checking the self-paced rule first.
